name: min-rtt
description: Send on the lowest-RTT path (stock, proven).

name: round-robin
description: Rotate packets evenly across all paths.

name: redundant
description: Duplicate packets on every path (lowest loss/latency, no aggregation).

name: sqm-weighted
description: Per-link SQM residual-bandwidth weighted split with a latency↔bandwidth slider.

tunables.label: Latency ↔ Bandwidth
tunables.help: 0 = concentrate on the lowest-latency path; 1 = spread for maximum aggregate bandwidth.

name: bbr
description: BBR v1: model-based, keeps queues short on stable links.

name: bbr3
description: BBR v3: BBR with loss/ECN-aware bandwidth probing.

name: cubic
description: CUBIC: loss-based, the conventional TCP default.

name: copa
description: COPA: delay-based, targets low queueing delay.

name: brutal
description: Brutal (Hysteria): sends at the rate Autorate allocates from the egress estimate, starting from the upload rate, under the peer's download, and compensates for loss.

tunables.label: Upload (Mbps)
tunables.help: Where the send rate starts until Autorate measures the link. Default 50.

tunables.label: Download (Mbps)
tunables.help: Receive rate advertised to peers (0 = no limit advertised).

tunables.label: Disable loss compensation
tunables.help: When on, the send rate is not raised to make up for lost packets.
